question.question: What is the primary benefit of implementing Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) in a network?

options.text: Reduces network congestion by load balancing traffic across multiple paths
Prevents network loops and reduces the risk of broadcast storms
Improves network security by encrypting all network traffic
Increases network availability by automatically rerouting traffic around failed devices

question.explanation: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) prevents network loops and reduces the risk of broadcast storms by ensuring that there is only one active path between any two points in the network.
